title: Auto Loans: Rate Discount Schedule
content:
The Auto Loans rate discounts are expressed in percentage points of APR. This schedule lists each discount's size per product, the checking tiers that count as a banking relationship, the most that discounts may remove in total, and whether ending autopay withdraws the autopay discount.

## Terms

- **Autopay discount**: the reduction, in percentage points, that automatic payment from a PCB checking account earns on the APR.
- **Relationship discount**: the reduction, in percentage points, available to a borrower who, on the date the loan funded, had a checking account in one of the qualifying tiers.
- **Qualifying checking tiers**: the official names of the checking tiers that establish the relationship.
- **Combined discount limit**: the largest number of percentage points all discounts together may take off the APR.
- **Autopay discount withdrawn on cancellation**: whether ending the autopay enrollment takes the autopay discount back out of the rate.

## Schedule

| Loan product | Autopay discount (points) | Relationship discount (points) | Qualifying checking tiers | Combined discount limit (points) | Autopay discount withdrawn on cancellation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 0.50 | yes |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 0.50 | yes |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 0.50 | yes |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 0.50 | yes |
| New Vehicle Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 0.50 | yes |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 0.50 | yes |

## Quick answers

**Are the discounts the same on every product?** Yes. Each product uses identical discount sizes, the same two qualifying tiers and the same combined limit; products differ only in their base rates and floors, which sit on the rate card.

**Does any other checking tier count?** No. Only Premier Checking and Private Client Checking are named as qualifying tiers.

**Is the autopay discount withdrawn when autopay ends?** On every product the answer recorded in the schedule is yes.
